reviewer: same retained original code-blind visual judge
scope: Cloudreach route-verge/terrain-dressing comparison at one supplied location; catalogue P2-021 broad flat grass/sparse fields versus layered upland land and ledges

inputs.setup: Parent-disclosed matched stands/headings/player-camera positions, Low/Compatibility Mesa and same graphics hash, clear/day.

reason: The supplied R/S views do not establish a persuasive difference in route verge dressing or foreground terrain layering. Both retain broad gently sloped/flat green grass areas with sparse isolated shrubs, trees and rocks around a narrow dirt route. Large stratified rock faces and distant grass-topped ledges give upland context, but the main route foreground remains a wide uniform grassy surface. Differences in cloud pattern and distant creature appearance are not evidence of the requested terrain/verge improvement.

per_view.finding: Dirt route to the stone gateway and trainer silhouette remain clear. Broad green verges persist. Right-side rocks/bush/flowers form one concentrated dressing cluster while most left/central verge is empty. The small left shrub appears separated above its ground/shadow; no improved contact is discernible between sets.

The gameplay view is dominated by broad uninterrupted grass flanking the path. Sparse low foliage is concentrated near the gateway; near/middle verge layering remains weak. Route and trainer stay readable. No useful dressing preference.

Reverse shows positive distant ledges, grouped left rocks and tall-grass strips near the far rim. The large foreground green field remains sparse in both sets. The isolated right shrub visibly appears to hover above the grassy surface with a separated shadow; same contact concern in both, not a demonstrated new candidate defect.

route_clearance: PASS for visible route readability in these three stills for both R and S: path remains distinct and unobstructed by dressing, trainer is whole and readable. No collision/traversability claim.
floating_and_clipping: Apparent hovering/contact gaps for the small left approach shrub and right reverse shrub in both sets. No new between-set floating or clipping difference is established. Missing detail view prevents closer base/contact assessment.
limits: One location, three approach/gameplay/reverse clear-day stills per set only. Detail missing after timeout. No all-catalogue, other quarters, earned route, motion, collision, full F40#1/#2/#5, full matrix or release acceptance claim.
